rfc6902-4-5d946f07.how: json-patch-tests spec_tests.json (RFC 6902 Appendix A) case A.13, an operation with two op members, is answered by refusal; prismpm build runs every acceptance vector of the snapshot guest (app/specs/snapshot/spec.json, written from the oracles by generators/snapshot) and GU-01 holds the pinned wasm to those vectors

rfc6902-4-d4abf196.how: json-patch-tests spec_tests.json (RFC 6902 Appendix A) case A.11, an add with the undefined member xyz, is answered by the document the add alone gives; prismpm build runs every acceptance vector of the snapshot guest (app/specs/snapshot/spec.json, written from the oracles by generators/snapshot) and GU-01 holds the pinned wasm to those vectors

rfc6902-4.1-06d0e10d.how: json-patch-tests spec_tests.json (RFC 6902 Appendix A) case A.12 and the 4.1 missing-object case, adds whose target's parent does not exist, are answered by refusal; A.1, A.2, A.10 and A.16 by the added documents; prismpm build runs every acceptance vector of the snapshot guest (app/specs/snapshot/spec.json, written from the oracles by generators/snapshot) and GU-01 holds the pinned wasm to those vectors

rfc6902-4.6-159a78dd.how: json-patch-tests spec_tests.json (RFC 6902 Appendix A) case A.8 is answered by the unchanged document, A.9 (a different string) and A.15 (number against string) by refusal; prismpm build runs every acceptance vector of the snapshot guest (app/specs/snapshot/spec.json, written from the oracles by generators/snapshot) and GU-01 holds the pinned wasm to those vectors

rfc6902-5-ec058a4b.how: json-patch-tests spec_tests.json (RFC 6902 Appendix A) case A.9, A.12, A.13, A.15 and 4.1, patches with an operation that fails or a document that violates the RFC, are answered by refusal of the whole patch, not a partial document; prismpm build runs every acceptance vector of the snapshot guest (app/specs/snapshot/spec.json, written from the oracles by generators/snapshot) and GU-01 holds the pinned wasm to those vectors
